title: FEATURE — disk guardian: auto-cleanup intermediate run files after ledger write
rationale: watchdog-latest.json: workspace/scs001/ is 10.5GB (threshold 5GB). Each vlog/multiformat run directory keeps avatar.mp4, avatar_branded.mp4, broll/, composited.mp4, subtitled.mp4, script.json after the final video is written to the publish ledger. These intermediates serve no purpose post-ledger-write and are consuming excessive disk. Solution: cleanup-run-intermediates.ts scans ledger, deletes intermediates from confirmed run dirs, keeps final video + meta.json. Wire into batch-produce.ts after each successful ledger write.
success_criteria: cleanup-run-intermediates.ts --dry-run lists intermediates to delete without modifying disk
cleanup-run-intermediates.ts (live) deletes intermediates for ledger-confirmed runs
Final video file (.mp4) and meta.json preserved in each run dir
batch-produce.ts calls cleanup after successful ledger write
npx ts-node scripts/scs001/batch-produce.ts --dry-run compiles without error

tasks.description: Create scripts/scs001/cleanup-run-intermediates.ts: scan publish-ledger.jsonl, for each confirmed run dir in vlog-runs/ or multiformat-runs/ delete avatar.mp4, avatar_branded.mp4, broll/, composited.mp4, subtitled.mp4, script.json. Keep final .mp4 and meta.json. Support --dry-run flag. Log bytes freed.
batch-produce.ts: after writeLedgerFallback() call, import and call cleanupRunIntermediates(runId) from cleanup-run-intermediates.ts to free disk space immediately after ledger write.
